content: Cloud Run functions (Cloud Functions 2nd gen) Python runtimes: python312 (deprecate 2028-10-02, decommission 2029-04-02), python313, python314 GA, python315 preview; python310 deprecated 2026-10-04. Limits: HTTP request 32 MB uncompressed (not increaseable), response 10 MB streaming / 32 MB non-streaming, Eventarc event 512 KB, timeout up to 60 min HTTP and 9 min event-driven, memory up to 32 GiB, concurrency up to 1000. Dependencies via requirements.txt or pyproject.toml; Pipfile unsupported. Firebase CLI supports Python functions and python312 in firebase.json runtime.
